info.title: Commerce Gateway API
info.description: Headless tenant-isolated JSON API. The bearer key determines the tenant; clients never select a tenant in a request. Unknown and other-tenant connection/operation IDs both return 404 after authentication. Mutations are durable asynchronous operations; 202 confirms enqueue, not Shopify completion. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Deployment administration and provider token endpoints are outside this public contract.

get.description: Checks a PostgreSQL query. This endpoint does not establish Shopify availability or worker health.

get.summary: List active connections owned by the authenticated tenant
get.description: UUID keyset pagination in descending ID order. Continue with pageInfo.endCursor while hasNextPage is true; no cross-request snapshot is promised. Unknown query parameters are rejected.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Decimal page size. Unknown query parameters and duplicate values are rejected.

200.description: A bounded page of active tenant connections; credentials are never returned.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Decimal page size. Unknown query parameters and duplicate values are rejected.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque product cursor returned as pageInfo.endCursor.

403.description: Merchant approval is missing a required permission; repeat the connection approval flow.

404.description: No active connection exists in this tenant.

409.description: Merchant authorization must be renewed; this is distinct from an invalid gateway bearer key.

429.description: Provider throttling. A bounded delay is returned for this safe read.

502.description: Provider rejection/version mismatch is nonretryable; an unknown read failure may be retried.

503.description: Transient provider read failure; retry after the supplied delay.

post.summary: Durably enqueue one product title update
post.description: Idempotency scope is authenticated tenant + connection + product_title_update operation kind + Idempotency-Key. Reusing a key with identical productId/title returns the same operation (202, replayed=true); changing either value returns 409. Keep the same key if a submission response is lost. A new key creates a distinct operation. Per-product FIFO preserves mutation order, and unresolved uncertain operations hold followers until administrator reconciliation/release. Poll the Location URL; do not blindly resubmit ambiguous writes.

202.description: Durable enqueue or identical replay, including an already terminal operation. Shopify completion is not implied.

404.description: No active connection exists in this tenant.

409.description: The scoped key already exists with a different productId or title.

get.description: queued/running/retry/recovering are nonterminal. succeeded and failed are terminal. uncertain is terminal with unresolved provider outcome: reconcile before any replacement write. blockedBy identifies the earliest same-product ordering hold, including an unresolved uncertain predecessor. orderingReleasedAt records an administrator release of this operation's ordering hold; status remains uncertain. Operation status remains readable after a connection is revoked.

200.description: Current operation and optional product-order blocker.

404.description: Operation is unknown or belongs to another tenant.

post.summary: Create a short-lived browser connection ticket
post.description: Authenticated tenant operation. The server selects that tenant's configured Shopify app. Open browserStartUrl in a browser; never send the gateway bearer to Shopify. returnUrl must exactly match an administrator-configured allowlist. The ticket is a sensitive single-use capability and expires in 120 seconds.

200.description: One-use browser start URL (not an access token).

400.description: Malformed body, invalid canonical shop, or return URL absent from the administrator allowlist. Codes are INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_SHOP, or INVALID_RETURN_URL.

get.summary: Consume a browser start ticket and redirect to Shopify
get.description: Browser boundary, not a JSON client flow. No gateway bearer is required. The one-use hashed ticket binds the tenant, shop and allowlisted return target selected by the authenticated connect request. Sets a secure browser-binding cookie, then redirects to Shopify for consent. This endpoint is not an unsolicited App Store installation entry point.

302.description: Browser binding established; follow the Shopify authorization redirect.

403.description: Ticket is missing, malformed, expired or already consumed.

get.description: Browser boundary. Requires the matching secure cookie, one-use 10-minute state, canonical shop, HMAC over all non-hmac query pairs sorted by key, and timestamp within ten minutes. Duplicate query keys are rejected. Tenant comes from stored state, never a query tenant ID. Successful callbacks clear the browser-binding cookie. Provider access/refresh tokens remain server-side.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds, no more than ten minutes from server time.

200.description: Connection saved when no return URL was configured.

302.description: Redirect to the exact allowlisted return URL captured before consent.

403.description: Invalid state, signature, cookie, timestamp or callback replay.

429.description: Provider token endpoint throttled; restart the authenticated connection flow.

502.description: Callback exchange failed; restart the authenticated connection flow.

get.summary: Check API and database health with a tenant bearer key
get.description: Checks the API and a PostgreSQL query after bearer authentication. Database failures during authentication or the readiness query return 503. Worker heartbeat is measured separately by the deployment health check.

post.summary: Receive a signed tenant completion notification
post.description: Outgoing request to the tenant endpoint configured by an administrator; this is not a gateway HTTP route. An enabled endpoint at first terminal transition creates one immutable event in the same PostgreSQL transaction. Delivery is at least once; deduplicate x-commerce-event-id and return 2xx for accepted duplicates. Verify the exact raw UTF-8 body with the tenant secret: sha256=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + eventId + "." + rawBody)), using constant-time comparison, and enforce a timestamp freshness window. Timestamp/signature may change on retry; event ID/body do not. Destination is public HTTPS port 443, DNS-validated and connection-pinned; redirects are not followed. Default limit: eight attempts and 24 hours; final failures remain in the database. Configuration changes invalidate older queued destination versions; there is no historical backfill.

2XX.description: Accepted; a duplicate immutable event must also be acknowledged with 2xx.

4XX.description: Final failure except 408/425/429, which are retried within the delivery budget.

gatewayBearer.description: Tenant-scoped gateway API key. Send only to this gateway; never place it in a URL.

browserStartTicket.name: ticket
browserStartTicket.description: One-use 120-second browser capability created by the authenticated connect operation.

oauthBrowserBinding.name: __Host-shopify_oauth
oauthBrowserBinding.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie generated by the browser start route.

shopifyCallbackHmac.name: hmac
shopifyCallbackHmac.description: Shopify callback HMAC verified with the stored tenant app secret; state/cookie/timestamp checks also apply.

notificationHmac.name: x-commerce-signature
notificationHmac.description: Outgoing tenant-specific HMAC; bind event ID, timestamp and exact raw body as described by the webhook operation.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds to wait before repeating a safe product read. Derived from retryAfterMs rounded up; bounded to 1..300 seconds.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed or out-of-bounds JSON, path or query values. Unknown body/query properties are rejected on JSON API endpoints.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked gateway bearer key.

InternalError.description: Sanitized internal/database failure. No upstream payload or credential is returned.

Title.description: Exact non-whitespace-only title; also limited to 255 UTF-16 code units. Whitespace is preserved.

returnUrl.description: Exact administrator-allowlisted HTTPS return target. Local development may allow an HTTP localhost target.

browserStartUrl.description: Sensitive one-use URL; do not log or share it.
